minimumMonthlyQuota.rule: This is a recurring minimum quota, not the terminal goal.

terminalGoal.rule: Every music work in the canonical catalog must become truthfully sellable and all three numbered units per work must be sold, paid, fulfilled and non-refunded. Books are excluded.

evidenceRules: Never count a work as sellable without its rights, printable master, mechanical preflight and exact Human-approved Offer.
Never count verification traffic, followers, views or simulations as demand, pipeline or revenue.
Never invent scarcity, social proof, ownership, signature, certificate, physical proof or another buyer.
Count terminal progress only from durable paid, fulfilled and non-refunded edition serials.
